Set on a 30-acre campus with modern learning facilities, Christway College offers a connected Christian community, supportive leadership and the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to its future.

Christway College is seeking an experienced VCE English Teacher for a full-time, ongoing appointment commencing January 2027.

This position will suit a teacher who values collaborative leadership, is committed to Christian education and wants to contribute to the development of a growing secondary school.

Salary and Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Christway College will align its teacher salaries with the Victorian Government Schools Agreement (VGSA) pay scale from February 2027. The anticipated salary range is $92,882–$133,456 + super, depending on experience and classification, subject to confirmation.

  • Relocation Assistance: Relocation assistance to a set amount may be available for suitable applicants , subject to discussion

  • Employment Security: Full-time, ongoing appointment commencing January 2027.

  • Curriculum Delivery: Plan and deliver high-quality VCE English Unit 1-4 programs, particularly Units 3–4, aligned with VCAA requirements.

  • Communication: Build positive relationships with students and families, maintaining clear communication about learning expectations and student development.

  • Curriculum Leadership: Contribute to the establishment and ongoing development of Christway College's VCE English program as the school welcomes its first Year 12 cohort.

Requirements

Teaching Qualifications and Experience

Applicants must demonstrate:

  • Relevant teaching qualifications and current Victorian Institute of Teaching (VIT) registration or eligibility.

  • Experience teaching VCE English Unit 1-4, particularly Units 3–4, or equivalent senior secondary English experience.

  • Strong understanding of senior English curriculum planning, assessment and examination preparation.

  • Full Australian working rights. Pathway to sponsorship is available for the right applicant.

  • Ability to provide two professional referees and complete HARKE Recruitment's safeguarding and onboarding requirements.

Christian Faith Requirements – Essential

Christway College is a multi-denominational Christian school where faith is central to its teaching, leadership and community.

Applicants must:

  • Have a personal commitment to the Christian faith.

  • Be actively involved in a Christian church community.

  • Support and uphold Christway College's Statement of Faith and Christian values.

  • Demonstrate how their Christian faith influences their teaching practice and contribution to College life.

  • Be able to provide a pastoral or church referee.

All applications must be submitted through HARKE Recruitment. Applications made directly to Christway College will be referred back to HARKE.
